question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, and should that behavior be opt-in or default-on?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and belongs at the plugin boundary if accepted, but it changes retrieval semantics, adds config/default surface, and creates persistent FTS-index/fallback policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve opt-in hybrid
options.body: Add a disabled-by-default hybrid mode with explicit config, FTS setup, fallback behavior, docs, and tests before considering a default change later.

options.title: Approve default hybrid
options.body: Make hybrid search the default and require stronger upgrade proof for current vector-only users and duplicate-threshold behavior.

options.title: Defer LanceDB parity
options.body: Keep memory-lancedb vector-only for now and direct users needing BM25 parity to memory-core or an external plugin.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in hybrid
recommendation.body: Add a disabled-by-default hybrid mode with explicit config, FTS setup, fallback behavior, docs, and tests before considering a default change later.
